source_refs.note: 'Interpreting Test Results' under topic 7.7, as printed (PDF 102, printed 98).

blocks.text: Interpreting test results involves understanding what statistical outcomes mean. It includes analyzing values such as p-values, confidence levels, or test statistics. Results help determine whether a hypothesis is accepted or rejected. Researchers must consider the context of the data while interpreting results. Misinterpretation can lead to incorrect conclusions. Clear explanation of results is essential for accuracy. Proper interpretation ensures reliable and meaningful findings.
